subject: general
question: The amount of profit and loss will be the same if an article is sold at ₹19,125 and ₹14,625. Find the percentage of profit if an article is sold at ₹19,125.
solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price 1 (SP₁) = ₹19,125

Selling Price 2 (SP₂) = ₹14,625

The profit and loss amounts are equal, so Cost Price (CP) is the same.

**Formula used:**

Profit Percentage = dfrac{Profit}{CP} times 100

Profit = SP - CP

**Calculation:**

Let the Cost Price (CP) be ₹x.

Loss = CP - SP₂

Profit = SP₁ - CP

Since the profit and loss amounts are equal:

⇒ CP - SP₂ = SP₁ - CP

⇒ x - 14,625 = 19,125 - x

⇒ 2x = 19,125 + 14,625

⇒ 2x = 33,750

⇒ x = 16,875

Cost Price (CP) = ₹16,875

Profit = SP₁ - CP = 19,125 - 16,875 = ₹2,250

Profit Percentage = dfrac{Profit}{CP} times 100

⇒ Profit Percentage = dfrac{2,250}{16,875} times 100

⇒ Profit Percentage = 13(1)/(3)%

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
